hints.content:
Casey is trying to find a **unit rate**, specifically the points per $1$ game.

$\dfrac{\blueE{\text{total points}}}{\maroonD{\text{games}}} = \purpleD{\text{points per game}}$

If we write each unit rate as a decimal, we can compare from the largest to the smallest place value.

Let's see what Casey did instead.

###Finding the unit rates

Player| $\blueE{\text{Total}}$ $\blueE{\text{points scored}}$ || $\maroonD{\text{Games played}}$||$\purpleD{\text{Points per game}}$
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
$\text{Daniela}$  |$101$|$\div$ | $5$|$=$|$20.2$
$\text{Casey}$|$154$ |$\div$ |$8$ | $\approx$|$19.3$
$\text{Hope}$ |$132$ |$\div$ | $7$|$\approx$| $18.9$

Casey calculated the correct unit rates.

###Comparing the unit rates

Player | Tens | Ones | $.$ | Tenths
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
$\text{Daniela}$  | $\redE{2}$ | $0$ | $.$ | $2$
$\text{Casey}$| $1$ | $\purpleE{9}$ | $.$ | $3$
$\text{Hope}$ | $1$ | $8$ | $.$ | $9$

Daniela scored the most tens of points per game.

Casey and Hope both scored $1$ ten of points per game, but between those two, Casey scored the most ones of points per game.

$\stackrel{\text{Least}}{\underbrace{18.9}_\text{Hope}} \,< \underbrace{19.25}_\text{Casey} < \stackrel{\text{Greatest}}{\underbrace{20.2}_\text{Daniela}}$

So Casey ordered the decimals incorrectly.

###The mistake

Casey ordered from greatest to least instead of least to greatest.

question.content:
Daniela scored $101$ points in $5$ basketball games.  Casey scored $154$ points in $8$ games.  Hope scored $132$ points in $7$ games.

Casey tried to order the players by their *points per game* from least to greatest, but he made a mistake. Here's his work:

$\begin{align}
{101}\div{5}&=20.2\\\\
{154}\div{8}&=19.25\\\\
{132}\div{7}&\approx 18.9\\\\
\stackrel{\text{Least}}{\underbrace{20.2}_\text{Daniela}} &< \underbrace{19.25}_\text{Casey} < \stackrel{\text{Greatest}}{\underbrace{18.9}_\text{Hope}}
\end{align}$

**What was Casey's mistake?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: Casey calculated games per point instead of points per game.
Casey ordered by number of points instead of by points per game.
Casey ordered from greatest to least instead of least to greatest.
